import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}, Test samples: {len(test_df)}")

# Get feature names - exclude id and species
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "species"]]
print(f"Features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Encode species labels
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
y_train = label_encoder.fit_transform(train_df["species"])
n_classes = len(label_encoder.classes_)
print(f"Species count: {n_classes}")

# Split training data for hold-out validation BEFORE training
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X_train_full, X_val_full, y_train_full, y_val_true = train_test_split(
    train_df[feature_cols],
    train_df["species"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["species"],
)

# Prepare data arrays
X_train_full_arr = X_train_full.values.astype(float)
X_val_full_arr = X_val_full.values.astype(float)
X_test_arr = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(float)

# Scale features once
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_full_arr)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val_full_arr)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_arr)

# Define regularization grid
C_values = [0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 5.0, 10.0]

# Ensemble approach: average probabilities across multiple models
ensemble_probs = np.zeros((len(X_train_scaled), n_classes))
model_names = []

for i, C in enumerate(C_values):
    print(f"Training model {i+1}/{len(C_values)} with C={C}...")
    model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=42, C=C, solver="liblinear")
    model.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train_full)
    probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_scaled)
    ensemble_probs += probs
    model_names.append(f"C_{C}")

    # Validate this model on hold-out data
    val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_scaled)
    val_loss = log_loss(y_val_true, val_probs, labels=label_encoder.classes_)
    print(f"  Model {model_names[-1]} validation loss: {val_loss:.6f}")

# Average ensemble probabilities
final_ensemble_probs = ensemble_probs / len(C_values)
final_ensemble_probs = np.clip(final_ensemble_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

print(f"\nEnsemble completed: {model_names}")
print(
    f"Average ensemble validation loss: {log_loss(y_val_true, final_ensemble_probs, labels=label_encoder.classes_):.6f}"
)

# Prepare submission file with correct column order
submission_rows = []
for idx, row in test_df.iterrows():
    image_id = int(row["id"])
    row_probs = list(final_ensemble_probs[idx])
    submission_rows.append([image_id] + row_probs)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    submission_rows, columns=["id"] + list(label_encoder.classes_)
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("\n=== VALIDATION METRIC ===")
print(
    f"Hold-out validation multi-class log-loss: {log_loss(y_val_true, final_ensemble_probs, labels=label_encoder.classes_):.6f}"
)
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Prediction shapes: validation={len(y_val_true)}, test={len(test_df)}")
